title: Can't BS the Bond Market: DS Roundtable 1

excerpts.label: Long-end yields at range highs—no support
excerpts.insight: Jimmy: Back of yield curve is the fly in the ointment—yields at range highs, price at lows, July/Sep moves left no support underneath
excerpts.pm_takeaway: WATCH 10Y/30Y LEVELS. Range highs with air pockets below = one catalyst away from breakdown. This is where equities derail.

excerpts.label: Can't BS the bond vigilantes
excerpts.insight: Lots of BS underneath this market, but bond vigilantes enforce what politicians won't—they can't be fooled like equity investors
excerpts.pm_takeaway: BOND MARKET IS THE CONSTRAINT. You can talk stock investors into temporary fixes. Bond market prices 10-30 years—it won't buy it.

excerpts.label: Hassett = bonds snap down, yields up
excerpts.insight: Team unanimous: Hassett pick triggers immediate bond selloff. No technical support below. Speed of rates will spook equities.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: FADE HASSETT RISK. If named, yields spike immediately—be positioned with steepeners or 10Y puts before announcement.

excerpts.label: Fed cuts more than 55bps priced
excerpts.insight: Only 55bps cuts priced Jan-June, but economy weakening, disinflation flowing through—team says more cuts likely
excerpts.pm_takeaway: LONG SOFR / FRONT-END. 55bps through June is too hawkish. Rents rolling off, unemployment ticking up—Fed has room to cut more.

excerpts.label: Mag7 concentration = fatter tails both ways
excerpts.insight: Nick: Can't rotate $3T into small caps—exits go to bonds/commodities. FOMO extends rallies, but crashes are harder when it fades.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: RAISE CASH INTO RALLIES. Concentration creates double-wide tails. FOMO keeps it bid, but no rotation cushion—prone to crashes.

excerpts.label: Gold above 4,000 is FOMO, not signal
excerpts.insight: Nik: Up to 3,500-3,700 was real macro signal. This last push past 4K is FOMO into a small market. Silver even more ridiculous.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: NO NEW GOLD POSITIONS above $4K. Last $500 is technical break + FOMO, not fundamentals. Taking no macro signal from it.

excerpts.label: Oil screaming buy if 56 holds
excerpts.insight: Jimmy: Venezuela gap-down that holds 56 = screaming buy. $50 is inflation-adjusted cheap. Break below = test low 50s/40s.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: BUY OIL on gap-hold at 56. Classic 'bad news, good price action' setup. Stop below 55.75. Tonight's action is the tell.

excerpts.label: Tariffs illegal = massive steepener
excerpts.insight: If SCOTUS rules illegal, tariff revenue lost, Congress can't pass (filibuster). 2-10s could blow out to 120-250bps.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: LOAD STEEPENERS before SCOTUS. Illegal ruling = deficit blowout = curve explosion. Don't short bonds outright—play the spread.
